persons.name: Jayajitāmitradeva
persons.evidence: sumatiḥ ... samalekhayad raghupater vaṃśodbhavo bhūmipaḥ ... mahārājādhirāja sūryavaṃśodbhava śriśrīsumatijayajitāmitradevasana ... dayakā juroṃ

date.as_written: śāke ? śūnyaśaśāṅkavāraṇamite pauṣe hi kṛṣṇe śanau pañcamyāṃ kila yonibhe ... samvat 810 pauṣa kṛṣṇa paṃcamī pūrvvaphālguṇīnakṣetre śaniścaravāra

notes: Although the Sanskrit verse begins with 'śāke', the chronogram 'śūnya-śaśāṅka-vāraṇa' (0-1-8 = 810) corresponds directly to the stated Nepal Saṃvat 810 during the reign of King Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur.
